title: cdk-construct-cloudtrail examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-cloudtrail/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — s3BucketName from bridge fixture logs.cloudtrail_bucket_name
- with-cloudwatch/ — cloudWatchLogsEnabled:true (divergent: adds CloudWatch log group + IAM role)
- multi-region/ — isMultiRegionTrail:true, with SNS and KMS from bridge fixture
- with-insights/ — enableInsights:true (divergent: adds Insights event selectors)
- with-data-events/ — dataEvents selector (divergent: S3/Lambda data event tracking)

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/cloudtrail-examples.test.ts.
